chapter.heading: For the Chief Musician. By David.
chapter.v:
In Yahweh,
I take refuge.How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

For, behold,
the wicked bend their bows.They set their arrows on the strings,that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

If the
foundations are destroyed,what can the righteous do?

Yahweh is
in his holy temple.Yahweh is on his throne in heaven.His eyes observe.His eyes examine the children of men.

Yahweh examines
the righteous,but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

On the
wicked he will rain blazing coals;fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

For Yahweh
is righteous.He loves righteousness.The upright shall see his face.
